## 2024-05-20 - Accessible Form Inputs and SSR Hydration
**Learning:** Using predictable auto-generated strings based on `label` for input IDs (e.g. `label.toLowerCase().replace(...)`) causes duplicate IDs if there are multiple similar fields on a page. When using Next.js or React 18, generating random string IDs causes SSR hydration mismatches between the server and the client. Furthermore, tying an input's `aria-describedby` dynamically to conditionally rendered error or hint elements requires these elements to have stable IDs.
**Action:** Always use the React `useId()` hook to generate unique IDs for components like inputs and their corresponding accessible description elements (error/hint spans). Use these IDs to connect the input to its messages using `aria-describedby` and set `role="alert"` on error messages so screen readers announce them.
